propositions: executor.py exceeds 790 LOC and approaches the 800-LOC hard cap with only 10 lines of headroom

Step-kind I/O contract model (declaration and static compatibility) can be cleanly separated from the run engine (control flow, expression resolution, dispatch) along a call-graph seam with no cross-cluster function calls

Moving the contract cluster (StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for, shallow_contract_check) to a new step_contracts.py module and re-exporting from executor.py preserves all existing import paths unchanged
The run-loop code and expression resolver that must remain in executor.py should not be relocated as they are targets of monkeypatch.setattr in tests and carry the budgeted '# read-via:' marker line
After the split, executor.py must drop to ~656 LOC (below the 720 near-cap band) and the new step_contracts.py must exceed 100 LOC, leaving real headroom without raising the limit
